title: Edmund and the Border
author: X. M. Okafor
blurb: Emrys Amberdale, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
